t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E20 - Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
st: Farscape: S3 E20 - Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
d: The crew must stop Scorpius's research on wormhole technology. The only way to stop him is to board the command carrier.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E21 - Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
st: Farscape: S3 E21 - Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
d: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E22 - Dog With Two Bones
st: Farscape: S3 E22 - Dog With Two Bones
d: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground where D'Argo is forced to destroy a rogue Leviathan that is attacking other ships.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E1 - Crichton Kicks
st: Farscape: S4 E1 - Crichton Kicks
d: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan named Elac, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E2 - What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
st: Farscape: S4 E2 - What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
d: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E3 - What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
st: Farscape: S4 E3 - What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
d: The crew discovers how far Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E4 - Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
st: Farscape: S4 E4 - Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
d: The crew is on the way to rendezvous with Moya. After ingesting a concoction of Noranti's they stop for a break on a planet.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E5 - Promises
st: Farscape: S4 E5 - Promises
d: Everyone finally reunites on Moya. But Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims to have saved the former Peacekeeper's life.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E6 - Natural Election
st: Farscape: S4 E6 - Natural Election
d: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E7 - John Quixote
st: Farscape: S4 E7 - John Quixote
d: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E8 - I Shrink Therefore I Am
st: Farscape: S4 E8 - I Shrink Therefore I Am
d: When Moya is raided by bounty hunters working for the Peacekeepers, every crew member is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E9 - A Prefect Murder
st: Farscape: S4 E9 - A Prefect Murder
d: While Moya and her crew are resupplying on a generally xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect while under a strange form of suggestion.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E10 - Coup By Clam
st: Farscape: S4 E10 - Coup By Clam
d: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. Although if not ingested by the same person, it becomes toxic.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E11 - Unrealized Reality
st: Farscape: S4 E11 - Unrealized Reality
d: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets up with a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E12 - Kansas
st: Farscape: S4 E12 - Kansas
d: After accidentally returning to Earth, Crichton discovers he is in 1985 and he has altered the timeline.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E13 - Terra Firma
st: Farscape: S4 E13 - Terra Firma
d: Crichton has arrived on Earth. Even though the Moya crew relaxes on Earth and are treated as VIPs, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E14 - Twice Shy
st: Farscape: S4 E14 - Twice Shy
d: Moya takes on a new passenger, Talikaa. However, Talikaa turns out to be an alien in disguise and is intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E15 - Mental As Anything
st: Farscape: S4 E15 - Mental As Anything
d: The males of the crew undergo some training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes. While D'Argo learns some self-control.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E16 - Bringing Home The Beacon
st: Farscape: S4 E16 - Bringing Home The Beacon
d: The women of Moya travel to a dead Leviathan to buy a sensor beacon for Moya which will allow her to appear to be a different ship.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E17 - A Constellation Of Doubt
st: Farscape: S4 E17 - A Constellation Of Doubt
d: John Crichton struggles to learn the location of the mysterious Katratzi, whilst watching a television documentary about himself and the aliens.
